headword: {入場|にゅうじょう}{禁止|きんし}

definitions.gloss: no admittance; entry prohibited; a sign or rule forbidding people from entering a venue or area
definitions.explanation: no admittance; entry prohibited; a sign or rule forbidding people from entering a venue or area

examples.japanese: {入場|にゅうじょう}{禁止|きんし}の{看板|かんばん}がある。
{未成年者|みせいねんしゃ}は{入場|にゅうじょう}{禁止|きんし}です。
examples.english: Minors are not permitted to enter.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}{中|ちゅう}のため、この{先|さき}は{入場|にゅうじょう}{禁止|きんし}となっております。
examples.english: Due to construction work, entry beyond this point is prohibited.

notes:
A compound of {入場|にゅうじょう} (entry to a venue) and {禁止|きんし} (prohibition). Commonly seen on signs at construction sites, restricted areas, event venues, and establishments with age or dress code restrictions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入場|にゅうじょう}{禁止|きんし}{区域|くいき} — restricted entry area
- {関係者|かんけいしゃ}{以外|いがい}{入場|にゅうじょう}{禁止|きんし} — authorized personnel only
- {入場|にゅうじょう}{禁止|きんし}になる — to be barred from entry

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {立入禁止|たちいりきんし} — no trespassing (broader; for outdoor areas, not just venues)
- {出入|でいり}り{禁止|きんし} — banned from entering (often a permanent ban on a person)
- {入場|にゅうじょう}{制限|せいげん} — entry restriction (limits rather than a total ban)
